rowValidation.uuid: nonempty JSON string containing ASCII decimal digits only
rowValidation.robTimes: numeric-like value strictly less than maxLootCount; no separate nonnegative check
rowValidation.notableEdge: Negative robTimes remains valid when robTimes < maxLootCount, matching the recovered literal predicate.

serviceScheduleTransaction.effectiveExecuteAt: Use executeAt when present; otherwise protectTime. Effective value must be positive.
serviceScheduleTransaction.expireAt: Persist only when present and > 0; otherwise SQL NULL.

batch.behavior: Iterates validated rows and schedules each row; stops on first service/database error; no per-row success aggregation.
batch.successResult: unit/null compatible with shipped frontend, which awaits but ignores the return value

implementation.backendDispatch: LWBridgeBackend invokes async command services before its synchronous switch, so the single-owner service receives the production command.
validation: Validate every row before the first persistence write.
Require positive supported server id, decimal-string uuid, positive executeAt/maxLootCount, and robTimes < maxLootCount.
Accept integer-like numbers and signed decimal numeric strings.
implementation.storeHandoff: Each validated row calls MapDataStore.ScheduleTruckPlunder using RecoveredWallClock.UnixTimeMilliseconds().
implementation.event: One immediate TruckPlunderChanged notification is emitted after a successful batch.
implementation.gameOperation: Scheduling itself is DB-only and does not claim the game-operation busy gate; the durable worker claims that gate only when due work executes.
implementation.serverDomainBoundary: Recovered public wrapper only proves serverId > 0. The rebuild retains the existing MapDataStore domain 1..99999; values above that domain are not claimed as exact original parity.
implementation.expiryBoundary: Current-v19 Truck scan does not source-prove a public expireAt field. A row with no explicit positive expireAt therefore persists SQL NULL. The rebuild does not invent expireAt from arriveTs.
implementation.executionBoundary: Durable worker executes only when the job server equals the current live server and never performs an implicit server jump.

remaining: Do not claim live Truck robbery acceptance until an explicit safe live test is authorized; a real robbery consumes a daily action.
Improve source-backed current-v19 Truck row fidelity where possible, especially maxLootCount/protectTime and post-success robTimes, without synthesizing values.
Keep cross-server Truck execution pending until explicit server-travel ownership is designed; current worker waits rather than jumping implicitly.
